lead.title: Gibberellin can now be switched on in chosen root tissues, a Nature Plants study reports
lead.summary: A team including Saitama and Nagoya universities built a system to control where the hormone gibberellin acts in Arabidopsis roots, according to an EurekAlert summary of a 27 October Nature Plants paper. The authors describe it as a tool for understanding how hormones coordinate growth across tissues. The result is in Arabidopsis only, and only the search summary was read, so no effect sizes are given here.

notes.label: Plant science
notes.text: tissue-specific hormone control in Arabidopsis roots (Nature Plants, 27 October); a basic-research tool, not yet a crop result.

plant.title: Spatial control of gibberellin action in Arabidopsis roots
plant.summary: Researchers including teams at Saitama and Nagoya universities used a system to control where gibberellin acts in Arabidopsis roots. They present it as a tool for studying how hormones coordinate growth across tissues. Arabidopsis-only result; effect sizes not seen.

plant.title: Decoding the genetic mechanism of peanut plant architecture for lodging resistance
plant.summary: Chinese researchers identified a branching-habit gene, AhPILS, that affects whether lateral branches of peanut grow spreading or upright. The aim is lodging resistance and safer production. Older than the 48 hour window; only the release summary was read.

plant.title: Higher CO<sub>2</sub> changes wheat protein composition, depending on cultivar
plant.summary: A Technical University of Munich-led study found that elevated atmospheric CO<sub>2</sub> can significantly alter the protein composition of wheat, and the size of the change depends on the cultivar. Older than the window; numbers not seen.

plant.title: A protein complex that may also be needed for plant reproduction
plant.summary: A Science Advances release describes a protein complex that may be required for reproduction in plants. Only a one line snippet was visible, so species and effect sizes are unknown. Older than the window.

plant.title: Bruno Pok Man Ngou (RIKEN CSRS) wins first Early Excellence in Science Award in Plant Science
plant.summary: The Bayer Foundation named Ngou as first recipient of the new award, recognizing work that could help breed disease resistant, higher yielding crops. Funder announcement, not a research result; older than the window.

biotech.title: Pairwise licenses its Fulcrum CRISPR platform to Wild Bioscience for AI-driven crop trait development
biotech.summary: Company announcement: Pairwise says Fulcrum tools will support AI-driven trait development at Wild Bioscience. This is a company claim and the page date could not be confirmed; Pairwise also licensed Fulcrum to Kaveri Seeds on 27 October (covered earlier).

ag.title: Smart farming starts paying off
ag.summary: A University of Bonn-led PNAS study estimates high-tech farming already pays off on 42% of the world's cropland. Older than the window; modelled estimate.

ag.title: Saskatchewan harvest 82% complete at 5 October, 17 points behind average
ag.summary: Southwest and west-central areas were at 92% while east-central and northeast were at 74%. Older than the window and a search-snippet reading; later reports could not be opened.

ag.title: Broccoli grown under magenta semi-transparent solar panels
ag.summary: Light use efficiency rose 4.5-fold and the crop grew as large as conventional broccoli, though it matured 25 days later. Older than the window; small crop-under-panel trial.
